headline: Pakistan Foreign Exchange Reserves Climb to Record $26 Billion
summary: Pakistan's foreign exchange reserves reached a record high of more than $26 billion amidst regional conflict developments.
why: Sovereign foreign exchange reserve accumulation strengthens import cover capacity and buffers external economic shocks for developing economies.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Record high foreign exchange reserves enhance national financial stability and external debt servicing capability.
